stem:
A student investigates standing wave in water. A sound source is placed at the bottom of a cylinder containing water. A microphone, attached to a rod, is placed above the sound source, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The sound source is connected to a signal generator. The microphone is connected to an oscilloscope.

The signal generator is set to a frequency *f*. The microphone is moved up away from the sound source until the maximum amplitude is observed on the oscilloscope screen. The distance *d*₁ between the microphone and sound source is measured.

The microphone is moved up a further 2.0 cm. The microphone is then moved down until the maximum amplitude is observed on the oscilloscope screen. A second value *d*₂ is measured. The average value of *d* is calculated.

The experiment is repeated for different values of *f*.

It is suggested that *f* and *d* are related by the equation

$v/f = 4(d + k)$

where *v* is the speed of sound in water and *k* is a constant.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of *d* on the y-axis against $1/f$ on the x-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and the y-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *f*, *d*₁ and *d*₂ are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of $1/f$ / 10⁻³ Hz⁻¹ and *d* / cm in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in *d*.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Plot a graph of *d* / cm against $1/f$ / 10⁻³ Hz⁻¹.

Include error bars for *d*.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the *y*-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *v* and *k*. Include appropriate units and include the absolute uncertainties in your answers.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the frequency *f* that gives a value of *d* of 30.0 cm.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: A sound source and microphone are arranged in a water-filled cylinder on a bench, with the microphone attached to a rod and connected to an oscilloscope and the sound source connected to a signal generator.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
figures.alt: A table with columns for frequency, reciprocal frequency, two measured distances, and their average distance, with six frequency rows.
A blank gridded graph with d / cm on the vertical axis from 4.0 to 26.0 and 1/f / 10⁻³ Hz⁻¹ on the horizontal axis from 0 to 0.7.
